title: RoomSpec v2 — Parameter Manifest Schema
description: Schema for a VR Experiment Studio room parameter manifest. Each room type produces one conforming document.
notes: v1 exposed 6 flat parameters per room.
v2 organises parameters into 8 sections: geometry, windows, doors, lighting, materials, furniture, plants, decoration.
Each parameter carries a routing field that tells the viewer how to apply a change.
Each parameter carries a construct field mapping it to an environmental-psychology construct.
infinigen_param is the corresponding Infinigen/home.py source argument where known; null otherwise.
This schema document is also the authoritative reference for the parameter type vocabulary.

routing_vocabulary.live: Handled by shader / light attribute update. No geometry rebuild. No iframe reload.
routing_vocabulary.cached: Requires switching between pre-generated scene variants. Triggers iframe reload.
routing_vocabulary.regeneration: Requires a new Infinigen generation run. Not applied in the browser.

type_vocabulary.range: Continuous numeric value. Fields: range [min, max], step, default (number).
type_vocabulary.integer: Whole-number count. Fields: range [min, max], default (integer).
type_vocabulary.categorical: One of a fixed option set. Fields: options (string[]), default (string).

key.description: Snake-case identifier, unique within a room manifest.

range.description: Required for type=range and type=integer. [min, max].

step.description: Slider step increment. Required for type=range.

default.description: Default value. Type must match the parameter type.

rationale.description: Why this parameter was included and what manipulation it enables.

infinigen_param.description: Corresponding Infinigen/home.py argument name, or null if not yet mapped.
